/* Full photographic captions retain a stable readable neutral backing. */
.d-orbitgallery[data-mode="full"] .d-orbitgallery-project-copy{background:#151515;text-shadow:none}
prompt: Preserve all seven original projects, genres, locations and years. Keep STEP=360/7, original wrapped angles, radius, rotation, scale, opacity, z-order and nearest-project selection. Replace placeholder project art with the exact five native photos, plus approved dusk and forestDark for the remaining full projects. The v 4 projection has five unrotated photo cards at its original positions and sizes; animate transforms and opacity, not layout dimensions. Complete project data: [{"title":"Afterlight","type":"01 / FILM","place":"Oslo · 2026"},{"title":"Soft Signal","type":"02 / IDENTITY","place":"Kyoto · 2025"},{"title":"Moraine","type":"03 / EDITORIAL","place":"Reykjavík · 2025"},{"title":"Night Index","type":"04 / DIGITAL","place":"Berlin · 2024"},{"title":"Field Unit","type":"05 / OBJECT","place":"London · 2024"},{"title":"Still Air","type":"06 / CAMPAIGN","place":"Lisbon · 2023"},{"title":"Common Ground","type":"07 / SPACE","place":"Mexico City · 2023"}] Full design size is responsive bleed; native plane is 372×264, scaled as a camera. Prefix every class with d-orbitgallery. Use plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no new runtime dependency. Match the exact v 4 native geometry and original assets. Keep the root transparent and full-view type at least 11px after fitting. Auto-scroll thumbnails through a six-second story with the exact Figma checkpoint at 40% of story time; reduced motion holds that checkpoint. Native input takes over. The shell owns Scroll ↓, Reset and Replay. Every hold freezes native scrolling and the story clock; deferred Reset cancels motion and restores the reference after resume. Dispose frames, animations, observers and listeners. Keep all original full interaction models and datasets. Accessibility: expose the component-local content without document-level landmarks; use valid named control roles and the complete list, row and cell ownership for this composition. Preserve all visible copy, native geometry, supplied assets, datasets, interaction models and motion recipes. In the full light Stage, use readable neutral ink (#171717 primary and #626262 secondary) with the unchanged composition and any original photographs. Keep existing text over photographs on its dark backing, use #b04a0b for readable orange labels and focus, and preserve the exact native v4 artwork, source clocks, scrolling model and complete original copy.
promptAppend: In full view, place all seven project captions on an opaque #151515 backing with #f1f1f1 text and no text shadow in both Stage themes. Preserve the original caption positions, dimensions, type, copy, photographs, transforms, opacity models and exact native v4 artwork.
